# Coverage Ledger {#sec-95-coverage-ledger}

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("R/_common.R")
library(knitr)
```

`PortfolioAnalytics` exports `r length(getNamespaceExports("PortfolioAnalytics"))`
functions. This appendix walks that namespace against the book's own source
files and records, for every export, the chapters whose code calls it. It is
generated at render time from `chapters/*.qmd`, so it cannot fall behind the
text. A capability with no chapter is either a deliberate omission or an
oversight, and the table forces the distinction: the omissions are listed at
the end with their reasons.

```{r}
#| label: scan
exports <- sort(getNamespaceExports("PortfolioAnalytics"))
files   <- list.files("chapters", pattern = "^[0-9]{2}-.*[.]qmd$", full.names = TRUE)
files   <- files[!grepl("/9[0-9]-", files)]          # narrative chapters only
chapter_of <- function(f) sub("^([0-9]{2}).*$", "\\1", basename(f))

# Code inside chunks and inline expressions; prose mentions in code font are
# excluded, because naming a function is not using it.
code_of <- function(f) {
  x <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  fence <- cumsum(grepl("^```", x)) %% 2 == 1
  chunks <- x[fence & !grepl("^```", x)]
  inline <- unlist(regmatches(x, gregexpr("`r [^`]*`", x)))
  paste(c(chunks, inline), collapse = "\n")
}
code <- setNames(lapply(files, code_of), vapply(files, chapter_of, character(1)))

uses <- lapply(exports, function(fn) {
  pat <- paste0("(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.])", gsub(".", "[.]", fn, fixed = TRUE), "\\s*\\(")
  names(code)[vapply(code, function(s) grepl(pat, s, perl = TRUE), logical(1))]
})
ledger <- tibble::tibble(
  export   = exports,
  chapters = vapply(uses, function(u) paste(u, collapse = ", "), character(1)),
  n        = lengths(uses)
)
c(exports = nrow(ledger), used = sum(ledger$n > 0), unused = sum(ledger$n == 0))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-95-ledger
#| tbl-cap: "Every export of PortfolioAnalytics and the chapters whose code calls it."
#| echo: false
ledger |>
  dplyr::mutate(export = paste0("`", export, "()`"),
                chapters = ifelse(n == 0, "—", chapters)) |>
  dplyr::select(export, chapters) |>
  kable(align = "ll", col.names = c("export", "chapters"))
```

## What is not covered, and why {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| label: unused
#| echo: false
unused <- ledger$export[ledger$n == 0]
legacy <- unused[grepl("_v[12]$|_v1tov2$", unused)]
other  <- setdiff(unused, legacy)
```

`r length(legacy)` of the `r length(unused)` unused exports are the `_v1` and
`_v2` legacy shims kept for backward compatibility
(`r paste0("\x60", legacy, "\x60", collapse = ", ")`); the book uses the
unsuffixed functions throughout, as @sec-01-setting-up-implementation explains.

The remaining `r length(other)` are
`r paste0("\x60", other, "\x60", collapse = ", ")`. Each is either an internal
helper that the package exports for its own use (`fn_map()`, `rp_transform()`,
`generatesequence()`, `scatterFUN()`, the `constrained_objective*()` family and
`objective()`/`constraint()` constructors that `add.objective()` and
`add.constraint()` call), a plotting wrapper superseded by a chapter's own
figure, or a capability the book declines on purpose. The declines are recorded
here so that an omission cannot be mistaken for an oversight:
`EntropyProg()` and the `centroid.complete.mc()`/`centroid.sectors()` variants
beyond those chapter 17 demonstrates, and `random_walk_portfolios()`, which
draws weights with no feasible-set structure and is dominated for every purpose
in the book by `rp_sample()`, `rp_simplex()` and `rp_grid()`
(@sec-28-robustness-implementation). If a name appears in this list that the
reader expected to find in a chapter, that is the place to say so.
